_readme: BOBRES license tiers: the paid tiers as entitlement sets, and what they cost.
This is the ONE file to edit (docs/pricing.md explains each field). After an edit, rebuild: the tools read it from the binary.
go run ./tools/license tiers            lists the tiers and their prices
licensesrv key create -tier standard    issues a license from a preset (docs/runbooks/vendor-license-server.md)
PRICES are placeholders: every "SET ME" is the owner's to fill (a plain number as text, e.g. "9"). The tools never read prices; they are for you and docs/pricing.md.
THE FREE TIER is not in this file: it is code (license.FreeEntitlements, internal/license/policy.go), and it applies to an install with no license once its trial is over. Its numbers:

1 server, 25 active services, 2 dashboard staff seats (the owner the install names takes none); the gateways zarinpal, idpay, nextpay, stars, manual_card, manual_crypto and manual_zarinpal, and the wallet;
no resellers, no white label ("Powered by BOBRES" is shown), no automatic USDT. There is no update limit: every release reaches every install.
THE TRIAL: every install gets 30 days from the first start of a version with the policy: unlimited servers and services, resellers, every gateway, 5 staff seats, no white label.
The trial preset below is the same, issued as a token (a test pins that). An install that has a license uses the license; one whose license ended uses the trial while it runs, then the free tier.

A license is never below the free tier: the install raises each limit a license sets or omits to the free tier's. The standard and pro presets name every gateway and grant at least the free tier (a test pins that).

Limits: -1 is unlimited and 0 is none, raised to the free tier's (so max_active_services 0 or missing still sells 25; the vendor tools print a WARNING). Gateways: zarinpal, idpay, nextpay, stars, usdt_trc20_auto, manual_card, manual_crypto, manual_zarinpal.

updates_until is not here: it is set per license, when issuing, and is only an informational date (updates are never withheld). grace_days is the default for a license of the tier; days is a fixed length.

standard.description: A store with a few servers: resellers, automatic USDT, five staff seats.

pro.description: No limits, and white label (no "Powered by BOBRES").

trial.description: 30 days of everything but white label, with 5 staff seats: the implicit trial, issued as a token for a prospect. It ends by itself.
